comparison.objective: Seat a shower cartridge against O-ring resistance and install its retaining clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain axial preload and angular alignment while inserting a U-clip with the other hand.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge flush and true, clip fully seated, 20 N pull retained, hands clear for 1 s.
comparison.reason: This is force-opposed assembly and clip insertion; the candidate instead separates multiple loose bodies by size through physical apertures.
